en: WASD/click: move  E: use  Stand behind the register to serve
zh: WASD/点击：移动  E：交互  站在收银台后自动结账

en: Order before opening or after closing: paid now, delivered before the next opening.
zh: 开店前或打烊后都能下单：下单即付款，下次开店前送到。

en: Pick what each slot holds; restocking keeps it full.
zh: 给每一格选商品，补货会自动补满。

en: No staff can be hired yet.
Click to place or select. R: rotate. Right-click: cancel.
zh: 点击摆放或选中，R 旋转，右键取消。

en: No storage that can hold that.
zh: 没有能放这种货的仓库。
不能拆掉最后一个门口。
已订的货需要放在这里。

en: That shelf can't keep this product.
zh: 这个货架放不了这种商品。

en: Stand in front of it first.
That save could not be loaded.
Carrying {qty} {product} to {fixture} slot {n} (E at storage to put back)
zh: 搬着 {qty} 件{product} → {fixture}第 {n} 格（在仓库按 E 可放回）

en: Carrying {product} to the {fixture} (E at cold storage to put back)
zh: 搬着{product} → {fixture}（在冷库按 E 可放回）

en: Steamed fish with ginger and scallion
That dish is sold at a different station.
zh: 这道菜要在另一种档口卖。

en: That is only for the kitchen.
Before opening choose a dish and today's target for each station slot. Short of ingredients the kitchen cooks until they run out.
zh: 开店前为每个档口格子选一道菜和今天的目标份数。原料不够时，做到用完为止。

en: No steam table or roast station yet.
zh: 还没有打菜台或烧腊档。

en: Dishes and what is in stock
That has to go against a wall.
Nothing is on order yet. Start the next day anyway?
zh: 还没进货，要进入下一天吗？

en: {per_slot} per slot · have {stock} (+{pending}) · last day {sold} · fits {room} more
zh: 一格 {per_slot} 个 · 现有 {stock}（+{pending}） · 上一天卖 {sold} · 还能放 {room}

en: Only a manager can run a department.

zh: 今天的班次（上午 | 下午）
任务优先级（数字大的先做）

en: Morale: wage {wage}, work {work} (days in a row {streak}, tasks today {tasks})
zh: 士气：工资 {wage}，工作 {work}（连续上班 {streak} 天，今天做了 {tasks} 件）

en: The importer does not sell that.
The importer has a minimum order.
zh: 不够进口商的最低起订量。

en: That is not a storage area.
Imports are cheaper but paid now and take a week or two by sea; they arrive on pallets to unload.
zh: 进口更便宜，但下单即付款，海运一到两周；到货是托盘，要卸货。

en: min {min} · {from}-{to} days at sea · local {local} · at sea {at_sea}
zh: 起订 {min} 个 · 海运 {from}-{to} 天 · 本地价 {local} · 在途 {at_sea}

en: Not available at this time of year.
zh: 这个时节进不到这个货。

en: The summer I graduated, I had a degree and big plans.
zh: 那年夏天，我大学毕业了。

en: I sent out dozens of applications. Hardly anyone wrote back.
zh: 投了几十份简历，回音寥寥。

en: The student loan statements, though, arrived right on time.
zh: 倒是学生贷款的账单，每个月都准时寄到。

en: {protagonist}, your dad... he collapsed at the store two days ago.
The doctor says he'll be fine, but he has to rest. No more long days.
zh: 医生说没大事，但必须好好休养，不能再累着了。

en: Can you come home? There's something we want to talk about.
zh: 你回家一趟吧，我们有事想跟你商量。

en: Your mom and I have run this store for twenty years.
zh: 这家店，我和你妈开了二十年。

en: But this body of mine can't keep up anymore.
zh: 可我这身体，是撑不动了。

en: We've decided to retire. And the store... we'd like you to have it.
zh: 我们商量好了，准备退休。店……想交给你。

en: Me? I've never even placed an order...
zh: 交给我？我连货都没进过……

en: Then you'll learn. You grew up in this store. What's there to be afraid of?
zh: 不会就学。你从小在店里长大，怕什么。

en: I'll keep it going for a while, for you.
If you get stuck, just call me.
zh: 有什么不懂的，随时打电话问我。

en: Even a while is enough. We're just glad you came home.
zh: 一阵子也好。你肯回来，我们就很高兴了。

en: Whenever you're stuck, give me a call.
zh: 遇到不懂的，随时给我打电话。

en: Oh, and since the store is yours now, the sign is yours to choose.
zh: 对了，店既然交给你了，招牌也该你来定。

en: Give it a name. We'll order a new sign once you've decided.
zh: 起个名字吧，想好了我们就去订新招牌。

en: "{shop}"... From today, this is my store.
Old shelves, a backroom packed to the ceiling. Just like when I was a kid.
zh: 货架有点旧，后仓堆得满满的，跟小时候一模一样。

en: Okay. Let's just get through today first!
zh: 好，先把今天撑过去再说！

en: Hey {protagonist}, it's me. Before you open, check the backroom and the shelves.
zh: 喂，{protagonist}，是我。开门前，先看看后仓和货架。

en: Click "Order" on the left, pick what's running low and set a quantity.
zh: 点左边的「进货」，挑要补的货，填个数量就行。

en: Whatever you order today arrives in the backroom before opening tomorrow.
zh: 今天订的货，明天开门前送到后仓。

en: Don't overdo it. Keep some cash on hand.
zh: 别一次订太多，手上要留点钱周转。

en: Delivery's in? Goods sitting in the backroom won't sell themselves.
zh: 货到了吧？东西堆在后仓，可卖不出去。

en: Walk to the backroom and press E to pick up, then press E at a shelf to stock it.
zh: 走到后仓按 E 拿货，再走到货架前按 E 放上去。

en: Short on time? Hit "Fill shelves" at the top.
zh: 嫌麻烦，就点上面的「一键上货」。

en: Full shelves make people want to buy.
zh: 货架满满的，客人看着就想买。

en: Open already? When customers line up, go stand behind the register.
zh: 开门了？有客人排队，你就站到收银台后面。

en: While you're behind the register, they'll come up and pay one by one.
zh: 人站在收银台后，客人就会过来一个一个结账。

en: Don't keep them waiting. If they get fed up, they'll drop everything and leave.
zh: 别让人等太久。等急了，人家放下东西就走。

en: Closed up? Good work. Now look at today's report.
zh: 打烊了？辛苦了。看看今天的报表。

en: What you sold, what you spent on stock, whether you made money: it's all there.
zh: 卖了多少、进货花了多少、赚没赚钱，上面都有。

en: Whatever sold well, order a bit more tomorrow.
zh: 哪样卖得好，明天就多订一点。

en: How's business? Let me show you how to set prices.
zh: 这两天生意怎么样？我教你改价钱。

en: Click "Prices". Every item has a reference price.
zh: 点「定价」，每样东西都有个参考价。

en: Too high and the aunties frown. Too low and you're working for nothing.
zh: 定高了，阿姨们一看就皱眉；定低了，白忙一场。

en: Try changing one and see how customers react.
zh: 改一样试试，看看客人什么反应。

en: Your mom says business is good?
zh: 听你妈说，店里生意不错？

en: Once you've saved enough, you can expand the store. Take a look under "Upgrade".
zh: 钱攒够了，就能把店面扩大。点「升级」看看。

en: But don't rush it. Expand when you're ready.
You used to do your homework on this counter. Now you're the boss!
zh: 以前天天趴在收银台上写作业，现在都当老板啦！

en: Of course I do. How's your dad feeling?
zh: 怎么不记得。你爸身体好点没有？

en: Resting at home. If you ever need anything here, just tell me.
zh: 在家休养呢。以后店里缺什么，您跟我说。

en: Good, good. Auntie will come by every day to keep you in business.
zh: 好好好，阿姨以后天天来照顾你生意。

en: You expanded? Knocked down a wall, swapped out every shelf...
zh: 店扩大了？墙打通了，货架也全换了……
老顾客来了，会不会找不到东西？

en: Dad, I want to sell meat and produce, so the neighbors don't have to go to the big supermarket.
zh: 爸，我想多卖点肉和菜，街坊就不用跑大超市了。

en: Don't worry. I'll take care of the regulars.
zh: 放心，我会照顾好老顾客的。

en: Then teach me how to change without losing what we had.
zh: 那您教教我，怎么改才不走样？

en: ...Alright. If you've made up your mind, I won't say more.
Just keep that cutting table clean every day.
zh: 切肉台记得天天擦干净。

en: Ha, so you still ask your old man.
Never run out of what the regulars buy. Everything else is your call.
zh: 老顾客常买的那几样，永远别断货。别的，你放手去做。

en: {protagonist}, did you see? A big Asian supermarket chain is opening down the street.
zh: {protagonist}，你看到没有？街口要开一家大型亚洲连锁超市。

en: I saw... They say everything's on sale opening week.
zh: 看到了……听说开业那周全场打折。

en: Your dad heard and didn't sleep all night.
zh: 你爸听说了，一晚上没睡好。

en: Mom, we can't beat them on price. But we can beat them on freshness, and on knowing our customers.
zh: 妈，价钱我们拼不过，可我们有新鲜，有人情。

en: Well said. Earn a good name and people will come back.
zh: 说得好。口碑做好了，客人会回来的。

en: Wow, is this really our little store?
zh: 哇，这还是我们那家小店吗？

en: A deli counter, fish tanks... bigger than I ever dreamed.
zh: 熟食柜、鱼缸……比我当年想的还大。

en: Honestly, at first I just wanted to keep it going for you.
zh: 其实一开始，我只是想替你们撑住这家店。

en: But now, every morning when I open up, I can't wait.
zh: 可现在，每天开门，我都很期待。

en: That's all I wanted. This store is truly yours now.
zh: 那就好。这家店，现在真是你的了。

en: In time, "{shop}" became the place the whole neighborhood went to.
zh: 后来，「{shop}」成了街坊们最常去的地方。

en: Mom and Dad still drop by now and then, pretending they're just passing.
zh: 爸妈还是会时不时来店里转转，假装只是路过。

en: You're buying whole pork primals? Then you need to know how to break them down.
zh: 你进整块猪肉了？那得会拆。

en: Put it on the cutting table. Belly, ribs and loin go separate; the scraps become ground pork.
zh: 放上切肉台，五花、排骨、里脊分开，边角料做肉馅。

en: Poor knife work means more waste. If you're swamped, hire a butcher.
zh: 刀工不好，损耗就大。忙不过来，就请个师傅。

en: Selling produce now? Let me teach you how to choose.
zh: 开始卖菜啦？妈教你怎么挑。

en: Leafy greens don't keep. Buy what you can sell; less is better than too much.
zh: 叶子菜放不久，卖多少进多少，宁可少进。

en: Mark it down when it wilts and tidy the stand when it's messy, so people want to browse.
zh: 不新鲜了就打折，摊子乱了就理一理，客人才愿意挑。

en: I hear you put in fish tanks? I always wanted to sell live fish when I was young.
zh: 听说你装了鱼缸？我年轻时就想卖活鱼。

en: Change the water often. Dirty water kills fish fast.
zh: 水要勤换，水脏了鱼死得快。

en: When a customer picks a fish, clean it on the spot. That's what fresh means.
zh: 客人挑了活鱼，现杀现卖，这才叫新鲜。

en: Starting a deli? Now that's my specialty.
zh: 要做熟食了？这个妈拿手。

en: Don't toss meat and vegetables near their date. Cook them and sell them: no waste.
zh: 快到期的肉和菜别扔，做成菜卖，一点不浪费。

en: Roasts should smell amazing, stir-fries should be quick, steamed dishes piping hot.
zh: 烧腊要香，炒菜要快，蒸的要热乎。

en: Mom! My student loan... I paid it all off today!
zh: 妈！我的学生贷款……今天全还清了！

en: Really? Dear, come listen to this!
Atta kid. You're doing better than I ever did.
zh: 好小子，比我当年还能干。

en: It all came from the store. Thank you for trusting me with it.
zh: 都是店里赚的。谢谢你们把店交给我。

en: Couldn't make the full loan payment this week...
One more line of arrears on the statement.
zh: 账单上的欠款又多了一行。

en: It's fine. Sell a bit more next week and catch up.
zh: 没事，下周多卖一点，补上就好。

en: {protagonist}, you know, you were such a good kid.
zh: {protagonist}，阿姨跟你说，你小时候可乖了。

en: After school you'd do homework on a box of instant noodles, then help your mom count change.
zh: 放学就坐在方便面箱子上写作业，写完还帮你妈数零钱。

en: I do. You said you'd open the biggest supermarket in town one day.
zh: 我记得。那时候你说，长大要开全城最大的超市。

en: ...Guess I'd better get to work, then.
We were just passing by. Only a quick look.
This case of soy sauce is crooked, let me—
Sit down! What did the doctor tell you?
zh: 你给我坐下！医生怎么说的？

en: Dad, leave it to me. You can supervise from the chair.
zh: 爸，交给我吧。您坐着指挥就行。

en: See? Our kid's all grown up.
There's an old notebook in the corner of the backroom... Dad's ledger.
zh: 后仓角落里有个旧本子……是爸的账本。

en: Every delivery, every sale, written neatly in fountain pen.
zh: 每天进了什么、卖了多少，都用钢笔写得整整齐齐。

en: One page says: "Rain today, no customers. Tomorrow will be better."
zh: 有一页写着：「今天下雨，没人来。明天会好的。」

en: {protagonist}, has the store been busy lately?

zh: 挺忙的，周末客人特别多。

en: Good. Busy or not, remember to eat.
zh: 那就好。再忙也要记得吃饭。

en: (in the background) Ask if the cooler temperature is set right!
zh: （在旁边）问问冷柜温度调好没有！
调好了调好了，爸您放心。

en: Excuse me, do you have... those spicy gluten strips? The kind from back home?
zh: 老板，请问有没有……那种辣条？我家乡的那种。

en: Spicy strips? Not yet. Which brand do you want?
zh: 辣条啊，现在还没进。你想要哪个牌子？

en: Any brand! I haven't had them since I moved here.
zh: 哪个都行！来这边以后好久没吃到了。

en: I'll make a note. I'll save you a pack from the next delivery.
zh: 我记下了，下次进货给你留一包。

en: Boss, this knife was handed down from my master.
zh: 老板，这把刀是我师父传下来的。

en: He used to say cutting meat is like living: go with the grain.
zh: 他说，切肉跟做人一样，要顺着纹理来。

en: How long did you train with him?
Ten years. The first three, he only let me sharpen knives.
zh: 十年。头三年，只让我磨刀。

en: Then my knife skills have a long way to go.
zh: 那我这点刀工，还差得远呢。

en: Morning, boss! I was at the docks by four.
zh: 老板早！我四点就去码头了。

en: Check the eyes. Bright eyes mean a fresh fish.
zh: 挑鱼要看眼睛，眼睛亮的才新鲜。

en: No wonder the live fish have been selling so well.
zh: 难怪最近活鱼卖得这么好。

en: Heh, I grew up in a fishing village. It's the one thing I know.
zh: 嘿嘿，渔村长大的，就这点本事。

en: Boss, today's braised pork is my grandmother's recipe.
zh: 老板，今天的红烧肉，是我奶奶的方子。

en: You cook the rock sugar to amber. Not one second longer.
zh: 冰糖要炒到琥珀色，一秒都不能多。

en: No wonder a customer said it tasted like home.
zh: 怪不得有客人说，吃出了家里的味道。
爸爸的提示：下一张订单（进货）

en: Dad's tip: put goods from the backroom on a shelf
zh: 爸爸的提示：把后仓的货摆上货架

en: Dad's tip: stand behind the register and ring up a customer
zh: 爸爸的提示：站到收银台后，完成一笔收银

en: Dad's tip: look over today's report (Report)
zh: 爸爸的提示：看一看今天的报表（报表）
爸爸的提示：改一次价格（定价）

en: Dad's tip: the store can be upgraded (Upgrade)
zh: 爸爸的提示：店面可以升级了（升级）

en: That conversation is not on screen.
Leave it empty to keep the old name.
Overdue amounts are added to the next payment.
zh: 逾期的部分会加到下次还款里。
现在多还一些（从现金扣）：

en: Off: no side stories. Dad's tips and the main story still play.
zh: 关闭后不再出现支线小故事；爸爸的引导和主线照常。

en: Paid an extra {paid} on the loan.
Could only pay {paid} on the loan; {due} still due.
Got it! That's one of Dad's tips done.
zh: 学会了！爸爸的这条提示完成。

en: That order is no longer open.
Finish the current group order first.
zh: 先完成手上的团购订单。

en: Is this the one from TikTok?
zh: 这就是网上很火的那个吧？

en: Mom wants me to grab soy sauce.

zh: 这里的饺子是全城最好的。

en: My friend told me about this place.
Do you sell by the case?
The kitchen needs this by Friday.
Wanted {product}, but the shelf was empty.
zh: 想买{product}，结果货架上已经空了。

en: {product} sells out fast here. Come early!
Nice store, but {product} costs more than elsewhere.
Good stuff but the line was slow.
Waited and waited, then gave up and left.
zh: 等了半天没人结账，干脆走了。

en: In and out in no time. Friendly staff!
zh: 结账很快，店员也很热情！

en: Grabbed {product} for dinner, tasted like home.
They have {product}!! Telling all my friends.
zh: 居然有{product}！马上告诉朋友们。
竟然没有{product}？大家都在聊它……

en: Wish the price tags were in English too.
Love the bilingual labels. Easy to shop here.
zh: 双语价签很贴心，买东西方便多了。

en: Our restaurant's order was ready on time. We'll be back.
zh: 餐馆订的货按时备齐了，下次还来。

en: They couldn't fill our restaurant's order.
zh: 餐馆订的货没备齐，太耽误事了。
双语价签：还没有（在“升级”里购买）

en: No reviews yet. They come in at closing.
zh: 还没有点评，打烊后会有。

en: No group orders right now. Restaurant buyers come once the store has 3 stars and both meat and seafood, and sometimes ask for a bulk order.
zh: 目前没有团购订单。店铺达到 3 星、并且有肉类和海鲜部后，餐馆采购会来店里，偶尔会下团购订单。

en: Order due at closing on day {day} ({days} days left):
zh: 进行中的订单，第 {day} 天打烊前交付（还剩 {days} 天）：

en: Goods for the order are set aside from storage as they come in and are not put on shelves. It is delivered at closing once complete; short on the due day, it is cancelled and reputation drops.
zh: 订单需要的货从仓库里预留出来，不会上架。备齐后在打烊时交付；到期还没备齐就取消，口碑下降。

en: Local shoppers are happier and buy more.
zh: 本地顾客更满意，买得更多。

en: A restaurant buyer wants a group order. Open Group to answer.
zh: 餐馆采购想下团购订单，打开“团购”看看。

en: Group order accepted: due at closing on day {day}.
zh: 已接团购订单：第 {day} 天打烊前交付。
团购订单没备齐，已取消。
餐馆的订货请求已过期。
有 {count} 条新点评，去“点评”看看。

en: {days} days to the Spring Festival: stock up on mandarins, candy boxes, red envelopes and nian gao.
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是春节，记得准备年桔、糖果盒、红包和年糕。

en: {days} days to the Dragon Boat Festival: stock up on zongzi and glutinous rice.
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是端午节，记得准备粽子和糯米。

en: {days} days to the Mid-Autumn Festival: remember the mooncakes!
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是中秋节，记得准备月饼！

en: {days} days to Thanksgiving: more shoppers will want deli food, snacks and drinks.
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是感恩节，熟食、零食和饮料会更好卖。

en: {days} days to Christmas: more shoppers will want deli food, snacks and drinks.
zh: 还有 {days} 天就是圣诞节，熟食、零食和饮料会更好卖。

en: Making zongzi at home this year.
The moon will be so round tonight.
The supplier will have no {product} from {start} to {end}. Stock up now!
zh: 供应商{start}到{end}没有{product}，赶紧囤货吧！

en: Wholesale prices for {department} go up {percent}% from {start} to {end}.
A hygiene inspector visits today around {time}: no spoiled goods on display, clean tank water, tidy produce stands.
zh: 今天 {time} 左右卫生检查员会来：货架上不能有坏货，鱼池水要干净，果蔬架要整齐。

en: Power cut today from {start} to {end}: chilled goods spoil faster and tank water fouls quickly.
zh: 今天 {start} 到 {end} 停电：冷藏商品坏得更快，鱼池水质下降更快。

en: Rain all day: fewer shoppers today.
zh: 今天一整天下雨，顾客会少一些。

en: A food influencer is coming today! Expect crowds after snacks and deli food.
zh: 今天有网红来打卡！会有很多人来买零食和熟食。

en: A supplier offers {qty} {product} near expiry (sell by {date}) for {cost} in all.
zh: 供应商低价推销 {qty} 件临期{product}（{date}前要卖掉），一共 {cost}。

en: A regular wants {goods} to collect tomorrow at {time}, and will pay {reward}.
zh: 老顾客想订 {goods}，明天 {time} 来取，付 {reward}。

en: The supplier is out of that right now.
No free spot on the wall there.

zh: 今天：{season}季{day}日 周{weekday}（第 {n} 天）

en: Red: festival day · pink: prep days · gold: today
zh: 红色：节日 · 粉色：准备期 · 金色：今天

en: Order festival goods from {date} until the day before.
zh: 节日商品从{date}起可以进货，到节前一天为止。

en: Power cut! Chilled goods are spoiling.
zh: 停电了！冷藏商品在变质。

en: Power cut: the generator keeps everything running.
zh: 停电了，发电机保证一切正常运转。

en: Not enough stock: the group order was missed.
